title: Host genetics highlights IFN-gamma-dependent Toxoplasma genes encoding secreted and non-secreted virulence factors in in vivo CRISPR screens
paper_method: Per-gene fitness scores, WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT t-tests
model: Toxoplasma RH tachyzoites, endomembrane/nucleus sublibrary (395 genes, 3,945 gRNAs), in vivo mouse passage
contrast: WT vs Ifngr1-/- mouse passage (17 vs 10); also in vitro (P4) vs WT (3 vs 17)
paper_calls: Table S2A: WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT per-gene fitness; ROP18 the shared IFN-gamma control
barcs_calls: WT vs KO: 160 genes at FDR 0.10 (90 depleted in WT); P4 vs WT: 229
named_hits: ROP18 #1 (FDR 3e-30); GRA12/GRA45 are not in this sublibrary
verdict: BARCS puts the shared positive control ROP18 first and agrees with the paper's WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT rankings (Spearman 0.28 and 0.43, top-100 overlap 58/100), adding sublibrary-specific candidates such as a YggS pyridoxal-phosphate enzyme and a glutathione S-transferase.
